blocks.text: Domain profiles let you create and manage profiles that can be used as part of Zscaler's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools to detect and take action on sensitive data across multiple channels. Domain profiles let you group organizational domains, custom domains, and personal email providers into a single entity that can then be applied to policy rules. To learn more, see About Data Loss Prevention, About Data at Rest Scanning DLP, and About Outbound Email Policy.
Domain profiles provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Manage personal email and organizational domains that you want to include or exclude from DLP policy rules across channels.
Let you group organizational domains, custom domains, and personal email providers into a single entity that can then be applied to policy rules.
Easily edit domain profiles to update all policy rules where the profiles are used.

blocks.text: On the Domain Profiles page (Data Security > Email DLP > Domain Profiles), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select filtering options for the table.
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all domain profiles created for your organization. For domain profiles, you can see:
Profile Name: The name of the domain profile. You can sort this column.
Recipient Domains: The recipient domains associated with each profile.
Description: Additional notes or information about the profile.
Edit, duplicate, or delete a domain profile.
